# Template Conventions

## Naming

- Lowercase
- Hyphen-separated
- English names

Examples

- daily-note.md
- project.md
- meeting.md

## Metadata

Templates must use the metadata model.

Metadata order is fixed.

## Markdown

Use ATX headings.

Use one blank line between sections.

Avoid trailing whitespace.

## Properties

Templates use native Obsidian Properties.

Property names must match `property-types.md`.
